description:
IJP Color UI and ImageJ plugins. Operations on color spaces and color images.
  • Color Calibrator - Color calibrates images using a color chart.
  • Color Calculator - Tool for converting individual color values between different color spaces.
  • Color Chart ROI Tool - Converts color chart ROI to individual chip ROIs. Measures the color of each chip.
  • White Balance - Performs White Balance of an RGB image.
